text:
mia_cs: Heads-up: starting coordination for the CUSP pilot cohort 12. We need to lock enrollment for five remaining seats, confirm kickoff slots, and get feedback capture flows wired. Tagging @sam_ae for account confirmation, @jordan_prod for enablement content, and @lia_eng for runtime gating.

sam_ae: Quick note 12: I have tentative yes from EmberWorks and NovaGrid, waiting on procurement for NovaGrid. Who else is in the bag?

mia_cs: Confirmed + pending list: EmberWorks (confirmed), NovaGrid (pending procurement), HarborSync (confirmed), QuantaX (pending), RivetHealth (confirmed).

jordan_prod: I'd like two distinct onboarding flavors: "quick-start" (30m) for product teams and "deep-dive" (60-90m) for infra/platform teams. We can reuse most slides but different demo scripts.

lia_eng: For the pilot we'll gate access with flag cusp_v2_beta. Once you give the final org list I can turn it on and attach a telemetry label so we can track pilot traffic separately. Note: there's a rolling infra update tonight; if it overlaps with kickoff we may see brief cold-starts.

amanda_ops: Ops checklist updates: provisioning runbook, seat assignment spreadsheet, calendar invites template, and a "post-kickoff health" survey piped to our tracker. Also adding a renewal-risk marker: any org that doesn't finish setup in 10 days will get AE outreach.

pilotbot: Reminder: EmberWorks kickoff tentatively scheduled 2024-06-19 10:30 PDT. Please confirm or reschedule within 48h.

mia_cs: Draft outreach we plan to send (short message):

"Hi <Name> - excited to have you in the CUSP pilot. Please pick one kickoff slot: Mon 6/19 10:30 PDT or Tue 6/20 2:00 PDT. Complete this 6-question pre-kickoff survey (2-3 mins) so we can tailor the session: https://forms.redwood.example/cusp-prework. We'll provision your seats and share the runbook after you choose a slot. Thanks! -Mia"

sam_ae: Suggest the survey includes: primary business use-case, expected monthly tokens/QPS, any compliance constraints, and a short renewal sentiment question. Also add a field for "who will be attending (names/emails)" so we can pre-provision.

jordan_prod: I'll split the enablement repo into quick-start and deep-dive decks. Quick-start will be a demo-focused 30m with a checklist for the first 48h. Deep-dive adds a troubleshooting appendix and perf tuning notes. I'll also add a 1-slide rollback/fallback plan in case of model routing issues.

lia_eng: Will add the flag and a small telemetry label (pilot_cohort=12). I'll also create a lightweight dashboard: seats provisioned, survey complete %, first-48h setup success rate, and a per-org latency median. That should help us surface early churn signals.

amanda_ops: Ops ETA: invites + seat provisioning after final list (EOD today) and survey webhook wired to the ops tracker. I'll also add a PagerDuty rule to page if provisioning fails 3x for an org.

mia_cs: Action items: @sam_ae - finalize confirmed list by 18:00 PT. @lia_eng - enable feature flags + dashboard after list. @jordan_prod - split decks and publish runbook. @amanda_ops - send invites and wire survey to tracker. I'll consolidate notes and post a short rollup tomorrow morning.

sam_ae: On it. I'll DM the final roster in ~45m.

lia_eng: FYI: the routing deploy may cause transient 3-8s cold starts for some pods for ~20m; I'll monitor and post alerts if we see anything > 10s.

amanda_ops: Logged renewal-risk workflow (OPS-3309). Also created calendar templates: "CUSP Quick Start - 30m" and "CUSP Deep Dive - 75m".

mia_cs: One more ask: let's add a simple NPS-style question after the pilot and an adoption checkbox (will you use Redwood inference in prod?). We can tie that to renewal-risk flags.

jordan_prod: Agreed. I'll add the post-pilot survey to the enablement repo and include suggested follow-up playbooks per response bucket.

sam_ae: Note on NovaGrid: procurement is the blocker; if they can't sign by EOD tomorrow we should offer next-cohort seats instead of leaving a seat idle.

lia_eng: Flagging: I will not enable flags for NovaGrid until procurement confirms; safe to keep them pending.

amanda_ops: Copy. I'll tentatively hold one seat as "procurement pending" until 48h lapse.

pilotbot: Kickoff plan created: https://docs.redwood.example/cusp-cohort12-plan (permissions: customer-success, product, eng).

mia_cs: Perfect. Thanks team :thumbsup: I
ill post a rollup after final roster. If anyone spots a high-risk org (low survey completion, procurement hold, or repeated no-shows) call it out here so we triage with AE and Product.

sam_ae: Will flag QuantaX if they don't respond in 24h 12 they asked for contract edits last week.

jordan_prod: I'll add a short "known issues" slide so AEs have language for customers hitting latency spikes.

lia_eng: Will monitor telemetry and ping if any anomalies.

amanda_ops: Confirmed invites and provisioning are queued pending final roster.

mia_cs: Thanks everyone. Follow-up tomorrow AM.

pilotbot: Thread archived by mia_cs.
